## Actual experiment
Run374 rejected normal-map-strength change. Test whether selectively lifting dark baked albedo texels improves side/crown without touching face or feet. The original 1024x1024 texture was sampled and 3D triangle centroids mapped to the UV atlas. For centroid (x,y,z), front=-(z+.01)/sqrt(x*x+(z+.01)^2). Weight=clip((y+.18)/.23,0,1)*clip((.48-front)/.55,0,1), with crown-only max against .65*clip((y-.30)/.13,0,1). Rasterize each face's weight into UV, extend to 4px nearest covered texel; luminance Y=.2126R+.7152G+.0722B; dark=clip((170-Y)/60,0,1). Apply RGB_new=RGB+(208,188,160-RGB componentwise)*weight*dark*k (target vector minus RGB), k=.45/.85. Embedded base-color image replaced with lossless PNG in appended GLB buffer, leaving original geometry and normal texture bytes intact. Reimport via trimesh and assert exact vertex and face arrays.

| variant | bytes | triangles | texels changed >2 | mean abs RGB change across entire atlas |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| .45 | 2051200 | 27372 | 17536 | .400287 |
| .85 | 2048856 | 27372 | 20241 | .765862 |

GLB SHA256 .45: 39d2f515e261a5ecf0461860da752d2f2b8eeb5837ebe5b44ef00df9d87383d4; .85: a8ac45bd700436d9b3e16ddc179311eb2d21391eeb0a50acf2f80c634523bcae.

VTK GLTFImporter under Xvfb, three meshes/variants separately loaded, nine actual 260x280 parallel-projection screenshots.
